name: Lua
description: Lua is a lightweight, embeddable scripting language prized for its speed, simplicity, and tiny footprint. It powers game engines (Roblox, Love2D), embedded systems, and configuration in Neovim and Redis. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Programming in Lua (First Edition)
items.description: Written by Lua architect Roberto Ierusalimschy. The authoritative free introduction covering core data structures, syntax, and fundamentals.

items.title: Lua Reference Manual
items.description: The canonical definition of the Lua language, syntax, standard libraries, and C API for all versions.

items.title: Lua.org Documentation Hub
items.description: Central landing page with installation instructions, technical papers, and VM/garbage collector explanations.

items.title: Lua News
items.description: Official project announcements tracking major milestones, foundation changes, and release updates.

items.title: Exercism — Lua Track
items.description: 117 coding exercises with automatic analysis and optional mentoring from volunteer Lua developers.

items.title: Codédex Lua Course
items.description: Modern interactive course with emphasis on game development and scripting in Roblox Studio.

items.title: Lua Programming Crash Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A comprehensive zero-to-hero video walkthrough for absolute beginners covering variables, control structures, and embedding.

items.title: Love2D Game Development (YouTube)
items.description: Intermediate-level projects building 2D games from scratch using the LÖVE framework and Lua.

items.title: Exercism — Lua Track
items.description: 100% free coding exercises from simple string manipulation to complex table-based algorithms.

items.title: Codewars — Lua Kata
items.description: Solve community-created coding challenges in Lua across hundreds of difficulty levels.

items.title: DevHints Lua Cheatsheet
items.description: A clean single-page reference covering syntax, loops, tables, metatables, closures, and standard API.

items.title: Lua 5.4 Reference Manual
items.description: The complete language and standard library reference for the latest Lua version.

items.title: Lua.org News Page
items.description: Official announcements from the Lua team on release updates, security patches, and version changes.

items.title: r/lua on Reddit
items.description: Community hub for news, project demos, and tooling discussions including Neovim configs and game engines.

items.title: Reddit r/lua
items.description: The premier community for Lua developers to share news, projects, and troubleshooting help.

items.title: Lua Mailing List (lua-l)
items.description: Official mailing list where language creators discuss compiler updates, performance, and proposals.

items.title: Stack Overflow — Lua Tag
items.description: Definitive Q&A for Lua troubleshooting, table operations, and C API integration.
